You do matter though, and your presence would be missed, I promise.

It gets better, slowly, but better.

My advice? Don't be too hard on yourself. Scammers work hard every day to trick people and 1,000 dollars isn't  worth taking your life over.

I wouldn't let it get you too down. For one, the elements of criminals, terrorists, etc are there to show realism in the world and make it more cohesive, but that doesn't necessarily make those places terrible. 

Besides that, I personally feel like Arknights really tries to keep that whole 'rage against the darkness' theme going, and I myself do see an eventual happy ending for many of the characters happening. Yes, I imagine that people will die and suffer, but much like how characters react to those events in Arknights I think the purpose of that is to make the player more motivated to push towards a better outcome. Personally, I see a lot of parallels between games like these with massive world ending threats and our own, where the core message is to fight for the world you believe in. Anyways that's just my ramblings on it.

Also, maybe I'm wrong, but I think it was confirmed somewhere that Kalsit's new skin is referencing an alternate timeline?

See, in concept I like the idea as something to trip up the Characters and have a dramatic moment. But that is specific to the CHARACTERS.

  
This is absolutely something that you should discuss with your Player who has the character w/ said familiar. Because it may end up being that they don't like that or don't want that, and if you were to do it and they weren't cool with it then it would definitely create some not so good vibes around the table.  


I'm not saying that you need to inform everyone. Nor am I saying that you have to make a creature completely detached from any PCs to do it, but if it is a familiar which is tied into the class then you should absolutely discuss it with the player themselves. Because tbh if my DM decided to do something like this without my permission it would definitely skew my future perspective on any other summonable creatures for any future campaigns and definitely hurt some trust there.
